scope: Candidate G original Ren 2024 Table 1 radio inputs: bounded public source-provenance recovery, no position propagation or image remeasurement

query_center.purpose: Locate printed radio records only, not an epoch-corrected association statistic

historical_implementation_status: Native rows corroborate printed coordinates and fluxes at published precision; Ren's actual query route, local software and exact historical catalog download are not recovered
global_frame_qualification: All four raw CDS responses label their coordinate system eq_FK5 J2000. This service label is recorded without asserting that every intrinsic radio frame is literally FK5. TGSS image SIA separately labels ICRS. No frame-bias correction or full covariance calculation was performed.

sources.release: Original 2021 paper-associated CIRADA epoch-1 Quick Look catalog; not a newer astrometry-corrected epoch-1 catalog

native_position_uncertainty.definition: PyBDSF fit uncertainties; not total absolute registration uncertainties

morphology.interpretation_limit: Catalog Gaussian morphology only; no image verification or resolved astrophysical identity claim

astrometric_systematics.published_qualification: Gordon 2021 section 3.3 gives original QL positional accuracy about 0.5 arcsec above Dec -20 degrees, with a population Gaia-minus-VLASS declination peak about -0.25 arcsec. Neither is a calibrated source-specific Gaussian sigma. CDS's shorter description says typical accuracy about 0.25 arcsec.
astrometric_systematics.newer_comparator_excluded: NRAO now distinguishes corrected VLASS1.1v2/1.2v2 images (approximately 0.2 arcsec typical accuracy) from original deprecated epoch 1 images (approximately 0.5 arcsec at this declination). Corrected positions were not silently substituted.

barriers: Original image URL from catalog returned HTTP 404 to a header-only range request; no FITS header or pixels acquired
Unknown local absolute registration and fit covariance
DATE-OBS recovered, but a separately weighted source-centroid observing epoch is not verified

native_position_uncertainty.definition: No per-source Gaussian position sigmas in this table. Official empirical positional uncertainty at 90% confidence is Size*(1/SNR+1/20) arcsec, using fitted pre-deconvolution major/minor size and SNR=(Fpeak-0.25)/Rms. An ellipse aligned to fitted PA, not independent supplied RA/Dec sigma values.

epoch_evidence.kind: source-specific weighted mean of contributing pointing epochs
epoch_evidence.definition: Flux-measurement epoch metadata from coadded observations; RMS is temporal spread, not uncertainty on the mean and not a hard observing interval

inferred_conservative_calendar_envelope.definition: Full calendar-year envelope inferred from documented survey campaigns, not G-specific dates and not mean plus/minus RMS

conservative_full_survey_interval.qualification: Conservative full-calendar-year envelope inferred from official Spring 1993 through Spring 2004 campaigns and Spring 2009 / Spring 2011 southern-cap additions. Not G-specific observation bounds; not derived from mean plus/minus RMS. Exact day endpoints are not documented.

morphology.interpretation_limit: Catalog Gaussian values, not an image or jet reconstruction

barriers: Do not replace the broad contributing epoch distribution with a single instantaneous snapshot
No individual pointing weights or exact date bounds recovered
The 90% empirical error expression is not automatically a one-sigma Gaussian covariance

sources.release: CDS edition created from author-provided NVSSCatalog.text.gz dated 2002-09-27; ReadMe dated 2002-12-24, last modified 2008-01-15

native_position_uncertainty.ra_unit: seconds of RA time, not arcseconds

epoch_evidence.definition: Catalog ReadMe describes centroids at the observation epoch 1995+/-2. This is a survey-level approximate interval, not a source-specific date or Gaussian epoch uncertainty
epoch_evidence.interval_derivation: Simple endpoints of the documented approximate 1995+/-2 description; not independently verified G observation bounds

barriers: No source-specific observation date or contributing snapshot list recovered
J2000 labels the coordinate convention, not the 1995-ish observing date
RA error requires proper units and tangent-plane cosine handling by the calculation owner

native_position_uncertainty.definition: Published 1-sigma catalog errors; include a 2 arcsec systematic contribution added in quadrature by the authors to fit errors

documented_survey_interval.definition: Published survey observation interval; G-specific contributing observations/weights not recovered

epoch_evidence.sia_metadata_qualification: ASTRON SIA calls this midpoint of observation and returns the identical value for all three overlapping mosaics. It is not accepted as G's observing epoch without validation against acquisition provenance; the documented survey dates govern the stated interval. No conversion or propagation performed.

morphology.interpretation_limit: Fitted, not deconvolved, axes; low-resolution single-Gaussian classification is not physical point-source proof

sources.frame_evidence: The original paper sections 3.3.1/4.4 says pointing positions above Dec -35 degrees were registered against NVSS and checks absolute positions against RFC. G is in that declination regime. The TGSS and NVSS registration evidence therefore is not wholly independent. CDS labels FK5/J2000; image SIA labels ICRS.
barriers: No G-specific observation epoch or constituent pointing weights
SIA date requires validation and must not replace the observation interval
Registration and morphology across frequencies prevent a naive independent proper-motion fit

actions_not_performed: Numerical position propagation or significance calculation
Substitution of newer corrected catalog data
